title: Fake son in an "accident" (impersonated family member)

out_of_character: asks for money over the phone
asks her to hide it from Papa

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mummy, it's me, Rahul. Mummy, I've had an accident.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Rahul? Are you hurt? Where are you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm okay but the other man is in hospital. The police say I have to pay fifty thousand now or they will file a case.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please send it to my friend's UPI, I'll give you the number. And don't tell Papa, he will get angry.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Beta, tell me our family code word first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mummy, there's no time for that! My phone is about to die.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's... I forgot, okay? Just send the money, please.
